title: PACK_FUSE carrier 10.7 x 26.4: F101 in a Keystone 3568 holder, 18 AWG pads J116 (BT104.+) and J117 (S05)
note: W2 PCB-SB2. Two-layer carrier of the pack fuse F101 on two PEM SO-M2.5-6ZI standoffs of the plate extension beside the battery tray (MECH-5 place; build/17 F39). Outline, holes and heights come from build/kicad/boards/PACK_FUSE/contract-proposal.json (no PACK_FUSE entry in the mechanical contract yet). Both battery nets are scripted 3.2 mm copper on both layers plus solid pours; nothing is autorouted. Insulation: no copper within 2.5 of the screw axes, polyimide tape over the bottom-side pin tails (build/17 F39). CI/model output only; not a fabrication release; the bench gates (7.5 A temperature rise, fuse-holder contact) stay OPEN.

layers.source: final-plan.json PCB-SB2 / A-PCB-10 decision: 2-layer 1.6 mm JLC standard for the small boards; decision 'Малі плати II: шари й мідь (W2 PCB-SB2)' in build/15

plan.F.Cu: F101 holder, J116/J117; E1_CELL4 and E1_SHUNT_P scripted 3.2 mm (class SCRIPTED_BATT in PACK_FUSE.kicad_pro) and pours
plan.B.Cu: the same scripted 3.2 mm copper and pours (current shared by both layers); no parts

rules_note: The rules live in the committed project file, the same set as pcb/boards/HATCH.json and ENC (track 0.25 / clearance 0.2, minimum 0.15 / 0.15, via 0.6 / 0.3, copper-edge 0.3, hole-hole 0.5, hole clearance 0.25, text 1.0 / 0.15), plus the board net classes named in layers.plan. pcb/rules/jlc-2l.kicad_dru is not attached: pcb/board_gen.py refuses a non-null rules_file (validate_spec).

post_route_zones.why: pour of the net half on both layers, solid pad connection (thermal spokes would be the narrowest copper of a 7.5 A path); the notch beside the hole stays 0.3 outside its keepout circle so the fill never meets the rule area (no sliver)

edge_keepout.why: rule-area strips (half-width 0.2) on every outline edge keep router copper 0.35 mm off the edge, above the project copper-to-edge 0.3 (as pcb/boards/PWR_B.json edge_keepout)

height_zones.why: holder column: mechanical.json layout pack_fuse, 16.17 above the board top
bottom end outside the holder column: layout pack_fuse_board ends at z 50.0 = 1.9 above the board top z 48.1 (screw heads k 1.85, J116 wire end)
top end, as the bottom end (J117 wire end)

heights_note: F101 = Keystone 3568 holder 7.37 + Littelfuse MINI 297 body 8.8 fitted (mechanical/params/parts.json keystone_3568, littelfuse_mini_297); J116/J117 = solder joint and the bent 18 AWG end, 1.9 = the pack_fuse_board envelope above the board (design value of W2 MECH-5: 'J116/J117 wire ends up to z 50.0')

router.why: both nets are fully scripted and locked (class SCRIPTED_BATT, not autorouted: the router does not count locked copper that crosses a pad as a connection, pcb/boards/PWR_B.json); fan-out pre-pass off: on PWR_B it escaped SMD pins with necked-down stubs and dangling vias (pcb/boards/PWR_B.json router.why)
